claim: John Griffin, a former CNN television producer who worked on the network for roughly eight years (including on Chris Cuomo's program), was arrested on December 10, 2021 in Vermont and pleaded guilty in 2022 to one count of using a facility of interstate commerce to attempt to entice a minor to engage in unlawful sexual activity. On June 20, 2023, U.S. District Court for the District of Vermont sentenced him to more than 19 years in federal prison plus 15 years of supervised release. According to the plea, in 2020 Griffin persuaded a mother he met online to fly with her nine-year-old daughter from Nevada to Boston, drove them to his ski house in Ludlow, Vermont, and sexually abused the child.
